docs.title: forecast
docs.text:
forecast(city: str) -> Forecast

Return the forecast for city.

Example

Client().forecast("Oslo").city 'Oslo'

Source code in src/weatherkit/client.py 
def forecast(self, city: str) -> Forecast:
    """Return the forecast for ``city``.

    Example:
        >>> Client().forecast("Oslo").city
        'Oslo'
    """
    return Forecast(city, self.provider.temperature(city))

docs.title: main
docs.text:
main(argv=None)

Entry point for weatherkit CITY.

Source code in src/weatherkit/cli.py 
def main(argv=None):
    """Entry point for `weatherkit CITY`."""
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="weatherkit")
    p.add_argument("city")
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    print(Client().forecast(a.city))
